issue.title: Fix xdist flake in artifact modal copy shortcut
issue.description: Discovered while verifying sase-bn. tests/ace/tui/modals/test_artifact_files_modal_copy.py::test_artifact_file_modal_y_copies_highlighted_markdown_contents_and_stays_open failed in the 22-worker non-visual suite because pressing y never invoked the mocked clipboard function (copied stayed empty), but passed immediately when rerun in isolation. Reproduce the scheduling/timing dependence and make the Textual interaction deterministic.
